section: Iterate — feature: root pyproject.toml and uv.lock as release manifests
title: TOML release manifests by table-scoped line edit with a re-parse check
context: FINDINGS D111: v0.37.0 bumped every plugin manifest but left the root pyproject.toml and the shipwright package in uv.lock at 0.36.0; neither was a declarable manifest (campaign dfp-changelog-followups, unit U1).
decision: New formats pyproject_toml and uv_lock in shared/scripts/lib/manifest_sync_toml.py: read with tomllib; write replaces the one version line inside [project] or the root [[package]] (source virtual/editable '.'), then re-parses and refuses unless only that value changed. The repo declares both root files.
consequences: Releases move pyproject.toml and uv.lock with every other manifest; uv lock --check accepts the result. New statuses missing_root_package and unsupported_version_for_format (TOML formats take only X.Y.Z). A layout the scan cannot place (dotted key, inline table, quoted key) is refused, never rewritten.
rationale: A line edit keeps every other byte (CRLF, comments) and needs no TOML writer dependency; the re-parse equality turns any heuristic miss into a refusal. Reviews: architecture approve x2; plan and external code findings handled; spec PASS; code pass (5 low fixed); doubt: 3 fixed, re-lock doubt rebutted by probe.
rejected: A file-wide regex on version = current; a full rewrite with a TOML writer (tomlkit/tomli-w); inserting a missing version.
